name: Wild Leather Vest

faq.answer: He asks for two Turtle Scale Breastplates, two Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine.
faq.q: What materials does Jangdor Swiftstrider require?

faq.answer: Jangdor Swiftstrider makes his camp at Camp Mojache.
Camp Mojache is the Horde settlement where Jangdor Swiftstrider waits for his leatherwork supplies.

sections.body: Turtle scale armor and rare wildvine must be gathered across the wilds. Carrying the finished breastplates, gloves, and vine to Camp Mojache fulfills Jangdor Swiftstrider's request.
sections.title: Supplies for Camp Mojache

summary: Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache requires specialized goods from skilled crafters. You are asked to supply turtle scale armor pieces along with a rare wildvine.
attribution: In-game quest text: Wild Leather Vest
